title: Mission Manifest
description: Schema for a content manifest. Lives at data/singleplayer/campaigns/manifest.json and data/singleplayer/scenarios/manifest.json, and determines which of the folder's content is loaded and in what order. Entries are IDs, not folder names. Only listed content is loaded; anything found on disk but absent here is ignored. An archive loaded at higher VFS priority may replace this file to reorder content or add its own.

identifier.description: A non-empty string containing only letters, digits, underscores, and hyphens.

$schema.description: Path or URL to the JSON Schema for this file.

campaigns.description: Campaign IDs to load, in presentation order. A campaign under data/singleplayer/campaigns/ is loaded only if listed here. Must match the 'campaignId' of its campaign.json.

scenarios.description: Mission IDs to load, in presentation order, for scenarios under data/singleplayer/scenarios/ — missions that belong to no campaign. A scenario is loaded only if listed here. Must match the 'missionId' of its mission.json.
